articleTitle: IoT application testing features based on the modelling network
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In the article the features of testing devices and IoT applications are investigated. To make the problem clearer, the basic aspects of IoT applications architecture are considered. A set of requirements to the testing is presented, which must be considered when planning and organizing the testing process for IoT applications. The difficulties that arise during the testing phase of IoT applications and systems are described, same as mane differences from the classic application testing. As an approbation of the proposed test specifications, a full-scale experiment was conducted to test a fragment of the communication network in order to select an application protocol for a typical IoT, according to the results the conclusions are made.

articleTitle: Development of mobile robot using LIDAR technology based on Arduino controller
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In the work, a software model based on the graph-based SLAM methodology is developed using the LIDAR technology, which allows direct and automatic control of the mobile robot in real-time. The architecture of the developed software and the main algorithms on which the work of the system is based is described. The technical support provided by the Arduino microcontroller is developed. Examples of application of built-in software are given.

articleTitle: Fully differential read-out circuitry components for MEMS-based accelerometers
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This paper presents outcome of introductory works concerning feasibility study for design of MEMS accelerometer readout circuit based on fully-differential signal processing path.

articleTitle: Image contrast enhancement in automatic mode by nonlinear stretching
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The problem of image enhancement in automatic mode is considered. A new method of contrast enhancement by adaptive nonlinear stretching using piecewise linear transformation of the brightness scale is proposed at which the average value of the brightness of transformed image is closest to the middle of the brightness range. The research of the effectiveness of the proposed and known methods of nonlinear stretching of monochrome images using the known no-reference metrics of integral contrast of image is carried out.

articleTitle: Image filtration using the Ateb-Gabor filter in the biometric security systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: A system of identification based on biometrie data is developed. The new method of Alteration by Ateb-Gabor was developed. Usage of this Alteration method gives an opportunity to utilize more control levels than usual Gabor fllter. Ateb functions are functions that have two parameters that enable more productive identification. This allows developing a new image processing method.

articleTitle: Environmental monitoring system for control of air pollution by motor vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In the paper, the architecture of software and hardware system for the environmental monitoring is considered. Its main tasks are determined. In particular, the prediction of air pollution by harmful emissions from motor vehicles using mathematical models and visualization of modeling results using website. Mathematical models are represented in the form of differential equations. They describe dynamics and spatial distribution of harmful motor vehicles emissions.

articleTitle: Implementation features of cellular composites microlevel structural models construction based on Voronoi tessellation and OpenCL technology usage
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The implementation features of cellular composites microlevel structural models construction method that is based on Voronoi tessellation and the technology of high-performance distributed computations OpenCL usage are described for the first time in this paper, which makes a practical value. The formalized algorithms, their corresponding software code and simulation results are presented.

articleTitle: Synthesis of non-equidistant location of sensors in sensor network
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The purpose of this work is to simplify the development and adjustment of software for placement of nodes of the wireless sensor network through the use of models at the design stage.

articleTitle: Software for visualization of reliability block diagram and automated formulation of operability conditions of technical systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This work presents the software for visualization of reliability block diagram (RBD), which allows formulate operability conditions of technical systems in an automated fashion.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of integrated precise joule micro-heater for lab-chip diagnostic devices
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The paper proposes a part of extended research devoted to application of Lab-Chip devices for real-time monitoring of the water quality in rivers, pools, lakes, etc. The diagnostic Lab-Chip detects hazardous species due to chemical reactions and further detecting. The crucial point is precise heating of the reaction chamber and maintaining stable temperature despite the exothermic or endothermic nature of the reaction. The goal of actual work was modeling, simulation and analysis of integrated precise joule micro-heater for Lab-Chip diagnostic device.

articleTitle: Implementation features of wounds visual comparison subsystem
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Implementation features of wound image processing and its further storing by developed wounds visual comparison subsystem are considered. Corresponding algorithm, program source-code, storage table and obtained results are shown that make a practical value.

articleTitle: A prototype of the mobile stethoscope for telemedical application
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Acquisition of sounds propagating from the inner areas of the body has been an interest of scientists and physiologists from the early 19<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> century. It has been proved that bioacoustic signals constitute a vital source of information concerning the patient's condition, especially in preliminary diagnosis. This paper describes the development of a telemedical electronic stethoscope with long-term auscultation functionality. The device is integrated with a Bluetooth module as well as analog and digital outputs. We also proposed an acoustic sensor integrated with the device, which is a promising solution for wearable applications. In our experiment, we recorded various acoustic signals from different body surface areas. As a final step of this research, we performed an analysis of the recorded data to evaluate the characteristics of bioacoustics signals which constitute the basis for automated disorders recognition.

articleTitle: Algorithms of automated formulation of the operability condition of complex technical systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The paper deals with the development of algorithms, which enable an automation of the reliability block diagram (RBD) processing and give an opportunity to build the reliability block diagram image of the technological system and automated formulation of the condition of operability of technical systems.

articleTitle: Application of fractional order transfer function with zero and pole in approximation of electromechanical systems high order objects
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The approximation of high order transfer function of an experimental electromechanical system by means of using particle swarm optimization method together with a proposed simple fractional order transfer function with zero and pole has been carried out and the accuracy of such approximation has been assessed through comparison of transition and frequency characteristics. The advantages of transition function approximation of induction generator with self-excitation by using fractional order transfer function with zero and pole have been displayed.

articleTitle: Using MEMS to adapt ultrasonic welding processes control in the implementation of modular robots assembly processes
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The paper proposes the solution of the problem of providing ultrasonic waves location orthogonality in accordance with the welding surfaces in modular robots assembly processes implementation with using MEMS as means of executive equipment sensing.

articleTitle: GPU-based biomedical image processing
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this research study, the authors developed an adaptive method and algorithm for image pre-processing and models of convolutional neural networks for cytological and histological image classification. The computer experiments were conducted on the basis of central and graphics processors using CUDA technology. Histological and cytological images of breast precancerous and cancerous conditions were used to test pre-processing and classification algorithms.

articleTitle: Influence of geometry scaling on comb-drive accelerometer performance
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper we present the design of one-axis comb-drive accelerometer. The 3-D model of such device was built and parameterized in Comsol. The scale factor was applied in order to enlarge the structure and increase the sensor performance. Mechanical and electrical behavior was investigated and basic parameters was extracted such as eigenfrequency, initial capacitance, capacitance change, pull-in voltage and shock resistance. Simulations showed that geometry enlargement increases the sensitivity of the sensor but it produces some negative side effects.

articleTitle: Mathematical model and boundary equilibrium of the cylindrical shell with elastic filling depended by the internal crack
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The problem of the boundary equilibrium of the weakened internal crack of a closed elastic-plastic cylindrical shell connected with an elastic filler is reduced to the solution of a system of nonlinear singular integral equations. The solution of the received system is constructed in conjunction with the plasticity conditions of thin shells, the conditions of stress limitations and the conditions of uniqueness of displacements. The influence of elastic medium, geometric and elastic parameters on the crack opening and the sizes of plastic zones is investigated.

Author Keywords: system of nonlinear singular integral equations

articleTitle: Intrusion detection method based on the sensory traps system
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper, intrusion detection system based on touch traps is presented. Aim of the work - investigate and design a software product for monitoring intruders in various systems for further analysis and prevention of repeated attacks. The work is designed for intrusion detection system that includes procedures for analyzing network honeypots and procedure for systematization received data. The results may be used for: Improving intrusion detection system; Providing users of intrusion detection system tool for operational monitoring of network honeypots; Providing additional tools for systematization of input data. The efficiency of the above-mentioned procedures verified by computer experiment.

articleTitle: Research of image processing methods in publishing output systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: For automatic processing of images in publishing output systems it is necessary to pre-reduce the noise level, to increase sharpness, to exclude the possibility of a moire, that is, to improve the quality of the image before printing. There are the results of using the Fourier transform for simple figure images. The amplitude spectrum values for blurry and detailed images are considered, and the methods of automatic processing of images in laser-type publishing systems are also shown.

articleTitle: Computer prediction of operability of bimetal cylindrical sensors under the influence of radio-frequency pulses
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The operability of a bimetal cylinder as a constituent element of embedded system under the electromagnetic action of amplitude-modulated radio-frequency pulses at the resonant frequencies of the electromagnetic field is studied. There are established the critical values of the parameters of the electromagnetic action at which the bimetal cylinder loses its load-bearing capacity as a contact joint.

articleTitle: User movement intention detection based on gait cycle capturing using force sensitive resistors
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Appropriate detection of user motion intention plays an important role in control of quasi-passive exoskeletons. Operating with user in “shadow mode”, those devices are required to apply selective damping only when it's most needed, without interfering in human locomotion energy saving mechanism. Therefore, proper distinction between actual gait cycle and other movement patterns should be performed with the highest possible accuracy. In this paper was presented an approach on determining gait cycle by using signals similarities algorithms. Data acquisition system composed from three FSR sensors was used for obtaining the gait pattern designated to further analysis.

articleTitle: Impact of Bluetooth low energy on energy consumption in Android OS
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to investigate impact of Bluetooth Low Energy on Android-based mobile devices. In order to achieve this, a simple application was developed, allowing for operation with beacons - a special class of BLE devices. After brief report and analysis of obtained results, additional case-specific methods of beacon interoperation optimisation are given.

articleTitle: Generalized method for prediction of the electronic devices and information systems' state
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Generalized nonlinear method of the prediction of the state of electronic devices and information systems provided that the parameters of the devices are measured with errors is offered. Filter-extrapolator is synthesized on the basis of generalized nonlinear canonical expansion. Method of extrapolation doesn't impose any essential limitations on the series of random processes with discrete argument which are under investigation (linear, Markovian behavior, stationary, monotony etc.). Special attention paid to the changes of the condition of electronic devices and information systems for achieving maximum accuracy of the prediction problem solution.

articleTitle: MEMS accelerometer in hexapod intellectual control
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The paper presents the results of three-axis MEMS accelerometer practical Introduction into the hexapod control system to solve the problem of classifying its states in real time. An experiment was conducted in which machine learning various methods possibilities were studied to solve the problem of classifying the current state of a walking robot. The best results for the accuracy parameter were shown by the method Medium KNN.

articleTitle: The remote labs as an effective tool of inclusive engineering education
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper the experience of Remote Laboratories development, implementation and usage for engineers training is presented. The structure of GOLDi network that unites partner universities from Germany, Ukraine, Armenia and Georgia is given. The possibilities of REIoT complex for study of Embedded systems design and Internet of Things technologies are described. Presented remote tools can be used for internationalization and improvement of inclusive engineering education.

articleTitle: Computer simulation of field-controlled percolation in 3D system of straight nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Analysis of percolation phenomenon in the system of straight nanotubes is carried out and an appropriate model of the process is proposed. An algorithm for finding the probability of nanotubes percolation is implemented using three-dimensional graphics visualization tools. The effect of geometric size and concentration of the nanotubes on the percolation probability was investigated. Based on the analysis of the dependence of percolation probability on the values of the dispersion angles determining the nanotubes orientation, the basic regularities of the conductive cluster formation under the influence of an electric field are established. The optimal parameters of the nanotube system with field-controlled percolation were determined.

articleTitle: Overlap estimation of two normally distributed systems based on Monte-Carlo simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The method for evaluating of the coincidence of two systems with normally distributed random variables is analysed. It is shown how Monte-Carlo method can be used for overlap estimation of probability distributions of two normally distributed systems.

articleTitle: The autonomous power supply for systems of acoustic climate control and traffic flows
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The autonomous power supply for systems of atmospheric and acoustic environment monitoring was designed and tested. The software for monitoring the charge of a solar battery was developed. A solar battery with a power of 250 W is used in the autonomous power supply system. In average, the solar panel works for 8-10 hours per day. It was calculated the number of solar panels for power supply and operation of atmospheric and acoustic climate monitoring stations in the autonomous regime without the participation of maintenance staff for a long time.

articleTitle: Machine learning gait analysis algorithm for ontogenetic features compensation
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: From the very first time when knowledge of exact human gait cycle phase was needed, numerous gait identification algorithms were proposed. Because of relatively simple nature in comparison to other phenomenons, some of those methods were based on foot-ground contact zone reactions. Regrettably, human gait is drastically complex process that differs from one person to another, not infrequently significantly, which causes numerous problems in creating its mathematical model. Due to this fact it is hard to create rehabilitation device control system based on traditional algorithms suitable for each person. In this paper we present comparison of signal similarities algorithms and adaptive neuro fuzzy inference system based gait phase classifier designed to counteract ontogenetic characteristics. Data sets composed of foot pressure sensors readings are provided to both algorithms to determine differences in each approach.

articleTitle: Selection of hardware features and synthesis of multilevel control system components of energy efficiency of production processes
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The development of enterprises are characterized by the intensive implementation of informational SMART technologies that provide automation of industrial processes and the acquisition of large quantities of data in real time. The control level of energy efficiency of production processes at the enterprise can be raised by developing a multilevel process control system, which integrate all monitoring and control functions into a single system. Hardware selection and system synthesis of such systems is important task today. Focus of this paper is hardware selection method for the synthesis of system components. That method allows finding a system configuration which meets initial requirements and limitations. The program based on this method was developed. This program can generate and filter design alternatives and decrease time required for system design.

articleTitle: On qualitative methods in the investigation of the nonlinear oscillations mathematical models in some electromechanical systems
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The qualitative results on the well-posedness of the problems about the nonlinear oscillations in the mechanical subsystems as components of some general electromechanical systems are obtained. Basing on these results and analog computation there is verified the sufficient adequacy of the obtained mathematical models of the nonlinear oscillations to their real prototypes. It is shown that the nonlinear environment conducts the quicker oscillation attenuation and causes the anharmonic processes in the system.

articleTitle: Engineering education for HealthCare purposes: A Ukrainian perspective
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper, the authors analyze the possibility of implementing novel innovative BSc and MSc curricula in artificial implants for bioengineering in Ukraine. The need for such curricula and the relevant stakeholders are identified first. Then, an analysis of existing curricula related to artificial implants in other countries is performed. Finally, the paper ends with an evaluation of foreseen risks for implementation of the curricula and the conclusions.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of multi-layer filter parameters calculation depending on application field
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The process of a sediment formation on a multilayered Alter is considered. The multilayer filters efficiency calculation method is proposed, which helps to ensure maximum dust holding capacity and minimum pressure differential in the diameter and thickness variations of fiber layers. According to the results of double-layer specimens studies the maximum amount of sediment is deposited on filters which packaging density is in the range of 0.03-0.06.

articleTitle: Meshing of symmetric structures in example of comb-drive accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper we present the design of one-axis comb-drive accelerometer. The 3-D model of such device was built and analyzed in Comsol. Mechanical behavior of the sensor was investigated and basic parameters was extracted such as capacitance change, pull-in voltage, eigenfrequency and shock resistance. Simulations showed that results are not precise. We found that the cause of such inaccuracy was incorrect meshing of model. Thus we show how to perform the mesh correctly to obtain precise results.

articleTitle: Tools for the recurrent laryngeal nerve stimulation in the tasks of its monitoring
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In the paper, the problem of recurrent laryngeal nerve (RLN) monitoring during surgery on the neck organs is considered. The method and tools for RLN identification among tissues of surgical wound are proposed. Compared to existing ones, they contain multifunctional tools for stimulation of surgical wound tissues. In order to increase the sensitivity in the known method of RLN identification, it is proposed to use a set of electro-stimulation tools by: direct current, alternating current with fixed frequency, and also a sequence of rectangular impulses. The proposed method is based on the theory of voice production by Raul Husson.

articleTitle: Development of multi-probe connecting deviceson flexible polyimide base for MEMS components testing
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper the problems of MEMS components testing are systematized. The design of multi-probe connecting devices on flexible base of polyimide that can be used for such components testing is described. Developed testing devices are researched from the point of view their design, fabrication technology and contact reliability.

articleTitle: DFT simulation of stacking faults defects in 4H-SiC
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper, the results of ab-initio simulation of crucial defects which are present in 4H-SiC are shown. Band structures and DOS for point defect and Stacking Faults (SF) are presented here.

articleTitle: Ensemble Monte Carlo simulation of 4H-SiC for electrons mobility calculation
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The article presents an Ensemble Monte Carlo (EMC) method as a part of new TCAD tool for simulating the properties of silicon carbide semiconductor devices. The potential calculation is based on Poisson's equation in finite difference scheme with appropriate boundary conditions. The charge density computed by the cloud-in-cell algorithm to avoid the statistical noise of the solution.

articleTitle: Fluctuations of internal electromagnetic fields as the means of electronic device authentication
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The article is devoted to authentication of electronic devices in information systems. Differences at the micro level of electronic devices lead to a change in noise characteristics. It has been experimentally confirmed that each electronic device is characterized by a specific autocorrelation function form of noise. This allowed forming the authentication template of the electronic device.

articleTitle: Model of the regional energy efficiency analysis based on the artificial neural networks
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The article elaborates on the structure and model of components of the neural network-based regional energy efficiency improvement system aimed at forecasting data on the basis of statistical data. It provides an example of component implementation using a multilayer perceptron. The system serves to monitor the energy consumption of the region and identify abnormal indicators. The component is regarded as a software library available on any platform.

articleTitle: Using WebSocket technology in a web application supporting the management of academic campus
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The effective management is very important in each organization. The work of units depends mainly on the manner in which the superiors manage them. However, effective management would be much more difficult if there were not tools that make management much easier. A great example of such a tool, can be a web application that supports the management of university estate. In the case of university settlements, we can honestly say, that several activities are common for every academic estate. These are activities such as the possibility of submitting different types of applications by people living in dormitories and their check by the management. Another great example can be the need of giving information about various types of events, such as bed linen exchange or checking the cleanliness of rooms. These and many other activities that can be done in the student houses would be much easier if there was a special dedicated tool, that would automate the work of people that manage the academic estate and dormitories, and would speed up many decisions for the residents of student houses. Nowadays, when computers are in almost every home and where the development of internet technologies is growing faster and faster, we can still find many places, where many issues need to be solved on paper. In the period when everything is becoming more and more automated, these key decisions should be moved from paper to computers, to be able to enjoy making important decisions.

articleTitle: Accuracy of marker location identification for investigation into mechanics of ball
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The paper concerns the selected issues related to research into applications of Magnus effect in sport. Main attention was paid to the accuracy of estimated position of marker stuck to the ball moving in the three-dimensional space. The authors proposed the method for identifying the marker centre of gravity coordinates on the basis of images burdened with different types of blurs. The problem of image reconstruction on the basis of registered noisy image was described by means of the Fredholm integral equation of the first kind. Blurs influencing the process of image registration were modelled by noise matrix computed as the Kronecker product of matrices modelling disturbances in the horizontal and vertical directions.

Author Keywords: Fredholm integral equation of the first kind

articleTitle: 3D MOS-transistor elements in smart-sensors based on SOI-structures
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper a modified design of the MOS-transistor in the smart-sensors based on SOI-structure is proposed, in which the surface of the subchannel region is made in the form of a cylinder segment oriented along the drain-source areas of the transistor. The dependence of the drain current of such a transistor reaches almost 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> μA/μm from the voltage at the outlet at different voltage values at the gate, which is an order of magnitude higher than for similar operating conditions of traditional MON-transistors.

articleTitle: Analysis of metal defectsby distributed cumulative histogram
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper an informative distributed cumulative histogram is proposed to analyze a metal and other surfaces having defects. The IDCH is used to illustrate and to measure an intensity and location of defects.

articleTitle: Reduction principle of the mathematical model and its applications
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The detection and elimination principle of redundant elements in the mathematical model is proposed in this paper. The efficiency of the proposed approach has been analyzed based on the neural network model of economic system and differential equations models of different nature.

articleTitle: Application of MEMS sensors for the automation of a laboratory stand for the measurement of the flow resistance of porous materials
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The paper describes a laboratory stand for the measurement of flow resistance of porous materials. The stand was modernized by introducing MEMS sensors. The measurement procedure was described, together with the data analysis method. The modernization of the stand was verified by comparing the results of the measurements obtained at the stand with the results of the measurements in an impedance tube for two different materials. The modernization of the stand allowed an increase of the accuracy of the airflow resistance measurement.

articleTitle: Sandwich beam micro-vibration suppression with magneto-reological core using refined layer-wise theory
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This article deals with the dynamic characteristics of sandwich plates consisting of external rigid layers and an inner layer with magnetorheological (MR) properties. The effect of the electric field on the frequency and the loss factor is also considered. Magneto-rheological viscoelastomer (MRVE) is used in sandwich plates for microvibration control. The dynamic behavior of MRVE during microvibration is characterized by the inhomogeneous complex module, which depends on the oscillation frequency and is controlled by a applied magnetic field. Partial differential equations for the coupled transverse and longitudinal oscillations of a sandwich plate are obtained from the conditions of dynamic equilibrium, physical and kinematic relations. This paper presents a new method for stress analysis for the accurate determination of detailed stress distributions in multilayer plates subjected to cylindrical bending. Here are some approximate methods for predicting the stress state for laminated plates. This method is adaptive and is not based on strict assumptions about the plate model. The described theoretical model includes the deformations of each layer of the plate, which take into account the effects of deformation of the transverse shear, transverse normal deformation, and nonlinear displacement changes with respect to the coordinate of thickness.

articleTitle: Special processor of information entropy estimates calculation of fixed-size signals binary realizations
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The digital special processor is developed in the paper, which allows to calculate the information entropy of fixed-size signals binary realizations. This processor extends the functionality of digital special signals processors, maintaining compactness in the presence of distortions caused by the influence of man-made noise.

articleTitle: Computer investigation of the process of thermoelastic energy dissipation in the electroconductive hollow cylindrical sensor under the radio impulse action
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper the investigation of the process of thermoelastic energy dissipation in the electroconductive cylindrical sensor under the radioimpulse action is presented. We obtaine that the influence of the process of thermoelastic energy dissipation on the maximum values of temperature and stresses is insignificant under the radioimpulse action of microsecond and milisecond duration and it does not affect the accuracy of the sensor measurement.

articleTitle: Control of the uniform distribution of a medical laser energy in space using MEMS scanners
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The application of MEMS scanners in medicine, in methods of treatment is considered. Was performed analysis of different types of scanners. According to a set of signs, the best performance is determined by electro-magnetic MEMS scanners. A model for the distribution of laser energy under a sinusoidal beam control law is constructed. Was detected areas of possible overdose, depending on the scan amplitude and radius of the beam cross section. The methods of increasing the uniformity of laser energy distribution over the surface are proposed.

articleTitle: Data processing method for public transport passenger flow of the “smart” city
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The method for data processing concerning the parameters of public transport passenger flow of the “smart” city was developed. The algorithms of primary processing of passenger flow data were built. The information model of automated system for the passenger flow data processing was created. The software models of the client and server side of the automated system were developed. The work result of the developed method for passenger flow parameters processing was presented.

articleTitle: Correlation analysis of periodic signals in the noise with the use of the Arduino platform
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: A correlation analysis of the periodic signal with noise received from the impulse sensor “PulseSensor”, using the Arduino platform and a signal frequency is determined. The novelty is that the proposed mathematical tool, in contrast to the classical Fourier analysis (development in the Fourier series of the investigated signal for each particular patient), makes it possible to determine the statement of its disease. A simple and reliable methodology (without attempt to present simulated process by a system of nonlinear differential equations that does not apriori accurately reflect the process itself and the exact solution of which in the general formulation is impossible to receive) finding of useful (determinant) signal by the maximum of its correlation coefficient is proposed. Phase discretization is necessary because the starting point of measurement is random, and the correlation coefficient of the investigated and reference signal with a minimum difference of their phases is informally valuable. This approach makes possible to highlight the useful signal at high noise levels which exceeds the level of useful signal.

articleTitle: Electrical equivalent model of MEMS accelerometer in Matlab/SIMULINK environment
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Modeling and simulation of MEMS devices is important part of whole process of their creation and fabrication. Knowledge of mechanical, electrical and thermal phenomena and their mathematical background is nowadays well supported with simulation and CAD tools. These tools used with highly developing High Performance Computing Systems are great environments for numerical calculation highly-detailed device models. Among many such tools family, Matlab/SIMULINK environment supported with various functional toolboxes is very easy and comfortable to use. The aim of this research work is to present possibility to implement electrical equivalent model of MEMS accelerometer in MATLAB/SIMULINK environment, present results of simulation and compare to mechanical model.

articleTitle: Control of the preresonance frequencies range width of the medical electro-magnetic MEMS-scanner at the design stage
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The application of MEMS scanners in medicine, especially in the methods of treatment, is considered. A review of existing types of scanners has been performed. According to a set of signs, the best performance is determined by electro-magnetic MEMS scanners. To expand the working area of the electro-magnetic scanners, a mathematical model is constructed, an expression found for the resonance frequency, which depends on the design parameters. Conclusions are made regarding the desired changes in design parameters for obtaining the best performance of the scanner.

articleTitle: MSoC device based on SOI-structures
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The architecture and topology of microsystem-on-chip for investigation of new structures and device elements is proposed. Realization of microsystem on silicon-on-insulator structures provides the small consumption of energy, increase fast-acting, radiation hardness and wide interval of working temperatures. The unified sensitive element is designed on silicon-on-insulator structures. The changes of informing signal parameters (capacities and/or resistance) are registered by circuits through the change of signal frequency of master supporting clock. The sensitive element has the regulated sensitivity and can be used for measuring of physical values of different type (of pressure, temperature, acceleration).

articleTitle: Radiation properties of plane array consisting of impedance microparticles
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The electromagnetic (EM) wave scattering problem on an array of small (micro) particles is considered using the asymptotic approach. This yields in receiving an explicit formula for components of scattered EM field in the case of one particle and a respective linear algebraic system (LAS) for unknown coefficients in the series of presentation of the EM field components in the case of many particles. The respective LAS for above coefficients is solved effectively by the successive approximation method. The radiation characteristics of plane array consisting of a set of impedance particles are studied.

articleTitle: Some methods for predicting recommendations for MEMS designer communities
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this article methods and algorithms for predicting recommendations for MEMS designers communities are considered. Methods use the qualification profile of the of MEMS designers. The search for MEMS designers communities two stages. In the first stage, the MEMS designers communities are searched for qualification profile of the of MEMS designers. In the second stage, MEMS designers communities are searched for the vectors of rating profiles. A method for improving the accuracy of calculating the similarity coefficients in the method of collaborative filtering is considered.

articleTitle: M2M communication protocol for low bandwidth MEMS sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper, we observe protocols suitable to support Internet of Everything (IoE) philosophy and values. Furthermore, we advocate an alternative approach to already known principles and employ new protocol as a container for M2M communications that is able continuously deliver data in a low bandwidth networks. We provide description of technology and data structures. Our reported findings are based on existing works and researches and extensive hands-on experience as well.

articleTitle: Current trajectory model of unbalanced load used for 3P-3W voltage source inverter control
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In The paper presents the model of the current space vector trajectory in case of one phase asymmetry of three phase three wires voltage source inverter based on the projective geometry. The scaling function was derived and the rotation operators were introduced for different cases of an asymmetry location. The whole analysis was conducted in the two dimensional Cartesian coordinate system by the output current space vector analysis. The transformation functions were defined and verified by simulation. Based on the elaborated transformation matrix, the new control strategy was implemented in the vector type modulator in order to eliminate the asymmetry. The investigated cases relate to the resistance asymmetry and resistant-inductance asymmetry of selected output phase. Based on the Power Sim simulation environment the mathematical model was investigated by the space current trajectory analysis. Presented results refer only to the unbalanced load caused by the one phase asymmetry.

articleTitle: High-speed three phase motor supplied from a single to three phase converter
publicationTitle: 2018 XIV-th International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The paper deals with the analysis and investigation aspects the drive with high speed induction motor supplied by power electronics converter. There is an increasing tendency to use this type of motors in many solutions. The experimental studies have been done, with new design of high-speed motor. This discussion concerns a high-speed machine with solid rotor mainly. The study induction machine have nominal power 1000 W and synchronous rotating speed 40020 rpm. The supply voltage 300 V is formed by a single-phase to three-phase power electronic converter.
